_comment: Shared verifier/allowlist config used by ALL providers. The 3 allowed URLs are the full (provider, symbol)-bearing URLs the deployed contract accepts (NUM_ALLOWED_URLS=3 in the lib). Request URL == allowed URL byte-for-byte; the local attestation_verifier has a one-character patch (`>` -> `>=` on the unconstrained `starts_with` helper) that allows this -- see contract/src/nr/attestation_verifier/src/lib.nr and the README 'Why we patch the local lib' section.
